title: Source SBOM
description: Every non-generated file in a published source payload, named by its exact content, together with a digest of that inventory as a whole. This is the schema only. An instance describes one candidate, is generated from that candidate, and is therefore not authored here: an instance written before a candidate exists would carry digests of nothing.

subject.description: The inventory this SBOM describes, which is a set the SBOM is not a member of. A commit or a payload tree object would name a thing this document is inside, so the subject is the digest of the non-generated files instead, computed before any generated file exists. No commit and no tree object may be named: they are not optional properties here, they are absent.

repository.description: The public repository identity, and nothing that locates a private working tree.

inventoryDigest.description: The content-and-mode tree digest of exactly the files listed below, computed by the stated spec version. A reader with the payload recomputes it rather than being told it.

inventoryFileCount.description: How many files the inventory covers. An empty inventory is not an inventory, so the minimum is one.

inventoryCoveragePolicy.description: What the inventory covers, as a constant rather than prose, so a verifier can assert it instead of reading it.

treeDigestSpecVersion.description: Which digest spec inventoryDigest was computed by. A digest with no stated rule cannot be recomputed.

excludedPaths.description: The four generated paths the inventory leaves out: both SBOMs and both metadata manifests. Bounded to exactly four, so a fifth exclusion or a missing one is refused here rather than argued about later.

generator.description: What produced this document. An SBOM whose producer is unknown cannot be reproduced, and an SBOM nobody can reproduce is a assertion rather than a record.

files.description: One entry per file. An empty payload is not a payload, so the minimum is one.

path.description: Relative to the payload root. Absolute paths and parent traversal are refused here rather than at extraction time.

spdxLicenseId.description: Required on every file. Licensing is a per-file condition: a file published with no stated licence is published under none, and a repository-level statement does not reach a file it does not cover.
